Key Role Details

This is a full-time paid internship program spanning ten weeks from June through August 2027. 
If you have previously interviewed for the Business Analyst role (AIP or ADP), we ask that you wait a minimum of 6 months from your last Powerday date. 
Participation in the internship requires that you are located in the continental United States with in-person attendance at your assigned location, in accordance with Capital One’s hybrid working model, for the duration of the program. 
Interns will be evaluated for a full-time position within our rotational programs, with start dates six months to one year following the completion of the internship.

Basic Qualifications

Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree or higher with an expectation that you will complete your most recent full-time degree program by August 2028 or earlier
(for example: If you are graduating with a Bachelor’s degree in May 2027 and are also currently enrolled in a full-time Master’s degree program with an expected graduation date of May 2028, then your most recent full-time degree program is your Master’s degree)

Business Analyst Internship - Summer 2027

As an intern in the Analyst Intern Program (AIP), you’ll apply your strategic and analytical skills to impactful challenges on an experienced and collaborative team, that drive company growth—like building strong technology-driven products for our customers, crafting our marketing and digital strategy, and analyzing the business impacts of credit approval and real-time fraud detection, just to name a few. You’ll have the opportunity to grow and explore, while being mentored by senior leaders and associates in our Analyst Development Program.

Whether you want to develop your strategic business acumen or refine your technical skills through coding and modeling, this experience will help launch your career journey. With the strong business foundation and supportive cohort of peers and leaders you’ll gain as an AIP intern, the career possibilities are endless.

Build your business acumen. Develop strategic problem-solving, quantitative analytics and communication skills. Armed with our best-in-class analytical practices, you’ll partner across teams to create new solutions to major challenges. 
Leverage technology to drive solutions: Refine your tech skills by learning tools such as SQL and Python to drive your analysis forward. Lean into a data-backed decision making approach as you evaluate efficiencies and solve business problems. 
Act as an owner. Drive recommendations, implement solutions and realize your impact, all while collaborating with cross-functional leaders. 
Reimagine banking. Use information, data, analytics, ingenuity and empathy in innovative ways to deliver technology-driven solutions for our customers. 
Be a change agent. Help people improve their relationship with their money. Transform the communities we serve through financial inclusion—helping to identify the right products for the right customers, assessing risks and optimizing our lending practices. 
Find answers. Develop hypotheses and set up your own analytical frameworks to test for the best solutions. 
Build and grow your network. Establish an impactful network of peers, leaders and mentors who will help you develop a clear and a vision for your career. 
Prioritize your wellbeing. Create your definition of balance through resources and benefits, while working in an environment that emphasizes creativity, collaboration, innovation and fun. 

You’ll love your internship if:

You ask why, explore and bring your unique perspective to the table. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and constantly seek out new challenges. 
You have a desire to take action, try new things, and fail fast so you can grow quickly
You’re organized and can juggle multiple deliverables while utilizing data analysis, technology and human-centered design to create solutions for our customers. 
You thrive in a collaborative and inclusive team environment where diverse perspectives and backgrounds are valued and celebrated. 
You have the desire and ability to connect and empathize with your colleagues and customers. 
You always keep the people around you in the loop and are excited to communicate ideas clearly to help your colleagues understand the “why” and key priorities. 

About Capital One

Over the last 30 years, Capital One has grown from a small credit card start-up pioneering the use of predictive modeling to democratize credit into one of the fastest-growing and most dynamic financial technology companies forever changing the way people and businesses interact with money. We believe our success is fueled by data and insights, deep customer understanding, innovative business strategy and a culture that prioritizes our associates’ growth and wellbeing. Our incredibly talented associates are passionate about changing banking for good and have the humility to understand that collaboration, fresh perspectives, ingenuity and empathy are all needed to make it happen.

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Logistics (AMZL) is seeking an experienced candidate to identify, create, develop and integrate innovative solutions and programs that lead to improvements in our last mile delivery network. This position will lead the development and execution of new worldwide transportation initiatives designed to improve overall efficiency and meet the ever-growing demand for last mile capacity. The successful candidate will have strong data mining and modeling skills and is comfortable facilitating ideas and working from concept through to execution.

Key job responsibilities

Own the development and maintenance of new and existing solution artifacts which are focused on driving efficiency within the business via analysis, metrics and reporting dashboards
Partner with operations/business teams to consult, develop and implement KPI's, automated reporting/process solutions, and process improvements to meet business needs.
Enable effective decision making by retrieving and aggregating data from multiple sources and compiling it into a digestible and actionable format.
Prepare and deliver business requirements reviews to the senior management team regarding progress and roadblocks.
Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions.
Design, develop and maintain scaled, automated, user-friendly systems, reports, dashboards, etc. that will support our business needs.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
Experience with Excel
Experience with SQL
Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience

First Derivative is driven by people, data, and technology, unlocking the value of insight, hindsight, and foresight to drive organizations forward. Counting many of the world's leading investment banks as clients, we help our clients navigate the data-driven, digital revolution that is transforming the financial services sector. Our global teams span across 15 offices serving clients across EMEA, North America and APAC.

As an EPAM Systems, Inc. (NYSE: EPAM) company, a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services, we deliver advanced financial services solutions by empowering operational insights, driving innovation, and enabling more effective risk management in an increasingly data-centric world. Together with EPAM, we combine deep industry expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients stay ahead in a rapidly evolving financial landscape, offering comprehensive solutions that drive business transformation and sustainable growth.

We need a strong Murex Front Office Business Analyst with a strong focus on Murex Front Office functionality and some workflow experience. The ideal candidate will have hands-on Murex expertise supporting FO users, including trade capture, pricing, and related workflows, and be comfortable working closely with business stakeholders and IT teams in a production environment. We want a pure Front office resource with skills in valuation, Risk analytics and MRA/MRB, pre-trade, etc.

Responsibilities

Support Front Office users on Murex, covering trade capture, pricing, and related workflows
Partner with business stakeholders and IT teams to deliver solutions in a production environment
Analyze and document complex business requirements, translating them into clear technical specifications
Contribute to or lead large-scale system transformation and implementation initiatives
Configure and support Murex across front-to-back workflows
Provide expertise in valuation, risk analytics, MRA/MRB, and pre-trade processes
Identify operational bottlenecks and implement resilient system solutions
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth day-to-day Front Office operations
Assist in workflow design and enhancements to optimize Front Office activities

Requirements

Front Office Murex expertise – strong knowledge of Front Office Murex modules alongside skills in valuation, risk analytics and MRA/MRB, pre-trade
Murex Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with the Murex platform, covering front-to-back workflows, system configuration, and support
Transformation Delivery: Demonstrated track record of contributing to or leading large-scale system transformation and implementation projects
Analytical & Communication Skills: Strong ability to translate complex business requirements into clear technical specifications, alongside excellent stakeholder management capabilities
Problem Solving: A proactive approach to identifying operational bottlenecks and implementing resilient system solutions

We offer

Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance (Subsidized)
Health Savings Account
Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care, Commuter)
Short-Term and Long-Term Disability (Company Provided)
Life and AD&D Insurance (Company Provided)
Employee Assistance Program
Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
Matched 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Time Off
Legal Plan and Identity Theft Protection
Accident Insurance
Employee Discounts
Pet Insurance
Employee Stock Purchase Program

EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our clients, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.

Engineer the Future with a Career at EPAM

Are you passionate about turning data into actionable insights that drive operational excellence? Join FedEx Global Trade Services (GTS) as a Business Analyst supporting a strategic transformation initiative focused on workforce management, operational visibility, data governance, and intelligent decision-making across Europe.

In this role, you will partner with Operations, Planning & Engineering, Technology, Compliance, and Data & AI teams to deliver reporting solutions, workforce management capabilities, AI governance processes, and data-driven business improvements. You will help shape how Clearance operations leverage data, analytics, and modern digital tools to improve productivity, service levels, compliance, and customer experience.

We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as a Business Analyst – Data, Insights & Workforce Management (Global Trade Services)

Position Summary

Are you passionate about turning data into actionable insights that drive operational excellence? Join FedEx Global Trade Services (GTS) as a Business Analyst supporting a strategic transformation initiative focused on workforce management, operational visibility, data governance, and intelligent decision-making across Europe.

In this role, you will partner with Operations, Planning & Engineering, Technology, Compliance, and Data & AI teams to deliver reporting solutions, workforce management capabilities, AI governance processes, and data-driven business improvements. You will help shape how Clearance operations leverage data, analytics, and modern digital tools to improve productivity, service levels, compliance, and customer experience.

Who We Are

FedEx is the largest express transportation company in the world, connecting more than 220 countries and territories. We work every moment to deliver the most important package of someone’s day. Our team of passionate people know their day-to-day work is invaluable in delivering outstanding experience to our customers. 530,000 team members strong, we are as diverse as the world we serve. We love what we do, and we do it well. Our reach is big, and so are our dreams. Join us and let's write our next chapter together.

What You Will Be Doing

Partner with Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Data & AI teams to identify opportunities for productivity and process improvements. 
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements for data, reporting, workforce management, and transformation initiatives. 
Support the development of Power BI dashboards and operational performance reporting. 
Analyze data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement. 
Gather and document business requirements for Workforce Management capabilities including Forecasting & Scheduling, Time & Attendance Tracking, Performance Management & Analytics, Employee Self-Service, and Compliance & Risk Management solutions. 
Support AI governance and compliance activities, including documentation, controls, and audit requirements. 
Facilitate workshops, stakeholder discussions, user testing, and adoption activities. 
Translate business challenges into scalable data, reporting, and technology solutions.
Support implementation of strategic workforce management, telephony, and operational performance initiatives. 
Facilitate workshops, process reviews, and requirements discussions. 
Support user acceptance testing (UAT), solution adoption, and change management activities. 

What Do You Bring With You

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
Ability to convert complex business challenges into practical solutions. 
Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities. 
Experience documenting business requirements, user stories, and process workflows.
Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and international environments. 
Strong attention to detail combined with strategic thinking. 
Fluency in English, both written and verbal. 
Willingness to travel within Europe when required (up to 25%). 

Preferred Qualifications

Degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field. 
Experience as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role. 
Experience with Power BI, reporting solutions, or business intelligence platforms. 
Understanding of data governance, data quality, and analytics concepts. 
Exposure to Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, machine learning, or AI governance frameworks. 
Experience working within regulated or compliance-driven environments. 
Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies. 
Experience within logistics, transportation, customs clearance, or international trade is an advantage. 
Business Analysis certification (CBAP, PMI-PBA, IIBA, or equivalent) is a plus. 

What Do We Offer

Opportunity to play a key role in the transformation of Clearance operations across Europe. 
Exposure to strategic initiatives with direct executive visibility. 
Experience working at the intersection of Data, AI, Operations, and Business Transformation. 
A collaborative and innovative international environment. 
Extensive professional development opportunities in analytics, AI, data governance, and digital transformation. 
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package. 
Flexible hybrid working arrangements. 
Tuition Assistance Program. 
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family. 

If you are passionate about innovation, technology, and solving complex business challenges, we would love to hear from you.

Bring your ideas, individuality, and dreams to our global community. Feel good about where you work. Choose your career path - we’re ready to invest in your development. Join FedEx.

Firma FedEx poważnie podchodzi do filozofii, która stawia pracowników na pierwszym miejscu. Jesteśmy pracodawcą zapewniającym równe szanse rozwoju dla wszystkich i zaangażowanym w budowanie różnorodnego i wolnego od dyskryminacji zespołu pracowniczego.

Nasza firma

FedEx to jedna z największych firm świadczących usługi transportu ekspresowego, która konsekwentnie uznawana jest za jedną z 10 najbardziej podziwianych firm w rankingu magazynu „Fortune”. Każdego dnia FedEx dostarcza rozwiązania transportowe i biznesowe dla swoich klientów pochodzących z 220 krajów i na obszarze całego świata. Obsługa tej globalnej sieci jest możliwa dzięki wyjątkowemu zespołowi pracowników FedEx zaangażowanych w dostarczanie usług najwyższej jakości.

Nasza filozofia

Filozofia P-S-P (ang. People-Service-Profit – Ludzie-Usługa-Zysk) określa zasady leżące u podstaw każdej decyzji, polityki lub działania firmy FedEx. Nasza firma troszczy się o swoich pracowników, a oni w zamian zapewniają perfekcyjną obsługę naszych klientów, którzy z kolei nagradzają nas dochodem niezbędnym dla zabezpieczenia naszej przyszłej działalności. Najważniejszym elementem, dzięki któremu filozofia People-Service-Profit ma tak pozytywny wpływ na firmę, jest zamknięcie tego koła poprzez wprowadzenie zysków z powrotem do działalności i inwestowanie w naszych pracowników.

Nasz sukces w branży jest zasługą naszych pracowników. Dzięki naszej filozofii P-S-P stworzyliśmy środowisko pracy zachęcające członków zespołów do stosowania innowacyjnego podejścia podczas świadczenia jak najwyższej jakości usług dla naszych klientów. Troszczymy się o ich dobro i doceniamy ich wkład w działalność firmy.

Nasza kultura

Nasz sukces w branży jest zasługą naszych pracowników. Dzięki naszej filozofii P-S-P stworzyliśmy środowisko pracy zachęcające członków zespołów do stosowania innowacyjnego podejścia podczas świadczenia jak najwyższej jakości usług dla naszych klientów. Troszczymy się o ich dobro i doceniamy ich wkład w działalność firmy.

Równość, równe szanse i różnorodność (EO&D)

Największym atutem FedEx są nasi pracownicy. Dlatego zobowiązujemy się do budowania zróżnicowanego, sprawiedliwego i inkluzywnego środowiska pracy, opartego na równych szansach, szacunku i uczciwym traktowaniu wszystkich osób - niezależnie od tego, kim są. Zachęcamy do aplikowania, również wtedy, gdy masz wrażenie, że Twoje doświadczenie nie w pełni odpowiada wszystkim wymaganiom zawartym w ogłoszeniu - może się bowiem okazać, że jesteś dokładnie osobą, której potrzebujemy na to lub na inne stanowisko.

Nie tolerujemy żadnych form dyskryminacji ani nękania, w tym ze względu na kolor skóry, pochodzenie etniczne, narodowość, wyznanie, płeć, wiek, informacje genetyczne, niepełnosprawność, stan cywilny, ciążę, orientację seksualną, tożsamość lub ekspresję płciową, ani jakąkolwiek inną cechę chronioną przez międzynarodowe i krajowe przepisy prawa. Zapewniamy odpowiednie dostosowania i warunki pracy, umożliwiające równy dostęp i równe traktowanie, zgodnie z obowiązującymi przepisami prawa.

Logramos prestar servicio con esta red internacional gracias a los excelentes miembros que componen el equipo de FedEx, encargados de que cada experiencia con FedEx sea excepcional.

Nuestra filosofía

La filosofía Personas-Servicio-Beneficio describe los principios que rigen todas las decisiones, políticas o actividades de FedEx. FedEx se preocupa por las personas que integran su plantilla y ellas, a su vez, ofrecen el impecable servicio exigido por nuestros clientes, que nos proporcionan el beneficio necesario para garantizar nuestro futuro. El elemento esencial que convierte a la filosofía Personas-Servicio-Beneficio en la fuerza positiva que es para la compañía radica allí donde cerramos el círculo y devolvemos dichos beneficios al negocio e invertimos en nuestra gente.

Nuestro éxito en el sector se debe a nuestros trabajadores. Mediante la filosofía Personas-Servicio-Beneficio, nuestro entorno de trabajo anima a que los miembros de los equipos sean innovadores a la hora de ofrecer un servicio de la mayor calidad posible a nuestros clientes. Nos preocupamos por su bienestar y valoramos sus aportaciones a la compañía.

Nuestra cultura

Nuestra cultura es importante por muchas razones y hacemos que cobre vida deliberadamente a través de nuestro comportamiento, nuestras acciones y nuestras actividades en cada rincón del mundo. La cultura y los valores de FedEx llevan siendo la piedra angular de nuestro éxito y expansión desde nuestros comienzos a principios de la década de los 70. A pesar de que otras compañías puedan copiar nuestros sistemas, infraestructura y procesos, nuestra cultura nos hace únicos y es, con frecuencia, un factor diferenciador en nuestra competencia y desarrollo en el mercado internacional actual.

Equidad, oportunidades y diversidad (EO&D)

En FedEx, nuestro mayor activo son las personas. Estamos comprometidos con la creación de una fuerza laboral diversa, equitativa e inclusiva, y ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades, trato justo y respeto a todas las personas, independientemente de quiénes sean. Le animamos a presentar su candidatura incluso si considera que su experiencia no se ajusta a todos los aspectos descritos en la oferta, ya que podría ser exactamente la persona que necesitamos para este puesto u otra oportunidad.

No toleramos ninguna forma de discriminación ni acoso por motivos de raza, color de piel, origen étnico, nacionalidad, religión, sexo, edad, información genética, ciudadanía, discapacidad, estado civil, embarazo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, expresión de género o cualquier otra característica protegida por las leyes y normativas nacionales e internacionales. Proporcionamos adaptaciones razonables a los miembros de nuestro equipo y a terceros para garantizar la igualdad de acceso, la inclusión y la equidad en todas las características protegidas.

jobs.description:
EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our team. The successful candidate will examine and document the structure of our existing databases, contribute to building new data models, and ensure alignment with business needs, rules, and regulations. This position calls for a solid grasp of data management, strong analytical abilities, and the capacity to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and data architects.

Responsibilities

Examine current database structures to gain insight into data flows, relationships, and dependencies
Record the existing database schema, data dictionaries, and data lineage
Pinpoint opportunities for improvement and optimization within current database structures
Work with product owners, data architects, and software engineers to design and build new data models that address business needs
Confirm that data models remain scalable, efficient, and consistent with best practices
Produce and update data models, diagrams, and accompanying documentation
Engage with stakeholders to collect and understand business requirements tied to data
Convert business requirements into technical specifications for data models and databases
Understand and apply applicable data governance, data privacy, and regulatory requirements
Verify that data models and database structures align with industry standards and regulations
Track and report on adherence to data governance standards
Build and roll out data quality checks and validation processes
Identify and fix data quality issues to preserve data integrity
Coordinate with software and data engineers, business analysts, and other IT staff to implement and refine data models
Share findings, insights, and recommendations with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Offer support and training to users on new data models and database structures
Requirements

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field
At least 2 years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst or in a comparable role
Proficiency in SQL along with experience using database management systems, such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server
Familiarity with NoSQL data stores and JSON document modeling
Strong understanding of data modeling concepts
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities
Knowledge of data governance, data privacy, and regulatory requirements
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to thrive in an agile, collaborative, and fast-paced environment
Excellent English proficiency (C1 level or higher)

Nice to have

Experience with data modeling tools, such as ERwin or ER/Studio
